about: Gubbar att välja mellan för en agent, utöver mallarnas egna (library/roles). En gubbe med `base` är samma person som mallen i andra kläder: porträttet görs från mallens.

characters.label: Teamleadern, ledig
characters.outfit: a chunky mustard knit sweater, dark straight jeans and white sneakers; no headset, nothing on the head

characters.label: Backend i kostym
characters.outfit: a well-fitted dark green suit with an open-collar white shirt and brown leather shoes; no headphones, nothing on the head

characters.label: Designern i snickarbyxor
characters.outfit: paint-splattered light denim overalls over a red and white striped long-sleeve tee, yellow sneakers; no beret, nothing on the head

characters.label: DevOps i varselväst
characters.outfit: an orange high-visibility safety vest over a grey hoodie, black work trousers and chunky boots; no cap, nothing on the head

characters.label: Utvecklaren i mjukis
characters.outfit: a teal retro track suit with white stripes down the sleeves and legs, white sneakers; no beanie, nothing on the head

characters.label: Arkitekten på semester
characters.outfit: a loud tropical print short-sleeve shirt, beige shorts, white socks pulled up and sandals; no pencil

characters.label: Webb i regnrock
characters.outfit: a shiny yellow raincoat, dark leggings and green rubber boots; hood down, nothing on the head

characters.label: Windows i lusekofta
characters.outfit: a traditional navy and white Scandinavian patterned wool cardigan over a white shirt, grey trousers and brown shoes; no tie

characters.label: Skejtaren
characters.look: Man in his early twenties, white Nordic, shaggy blond hair to the jaw, tall and skinny, oversized faded green t-shirt, baggy jeans, chunky skate shoes. Nothing on the head.

characters.label: Professorn
characters.look: Woman in her seventies, Black, short grey curls, small and upright, brown tweed jacket with elbow patches over a cream blouse, long dark green skirt, sensible brown shoes. Nothing on the head.

characters.label: Spelnörden
characters.look: Man in his thirties, white, big bushy red beard and short red hair, tall and heavyset, purple retro arcade t-shirt with a pixel spaceship, khaki cargo shorts, black sneakers with tall white socks. Nothing on the head.

characters.label: Löparen
characters.look: Woman in her twenties, East African, very short cropped hair, athletic and lean, bright coral running jacket, black leggings, neon running shoes. Nothing on the head.

characters.label: Goten
characters.look: Person in their twenties, very pale, long straight black hair with blunt bangs, slim, black long-sleeve top with silver chains, black jeans, black platform boots, black nail polish. Nothing on the head.

characters.label: Pappan
characters.look: Man in his fifties, Latino, salt-and-pepper hair and moustache, round belly, light blue polo shirt tucked into beige chinos with a brown belt, very white sneakers. Nothing on the head.

characters.label: Läraren
characters.look: Woman in her thirties, Middle Eastern, wearing a deep teal hijab, slim, long cream knit cardigan over a white top, wide black trousers, white sneakers.

characters.label: Punkaren
characters.look: Woman in her forties, Japanese, electric blue undercut swept to one side, average build, black leather jacket covered in round pins, ripped grey jeans, red high-top sneakers. Nothing on the head.

characters.label: Tomten
characters.look: A jolly old Swedish jultomte, round belly, rosy cheeks, twinkling eyes, small round gold-rimmed glasses, a long fluffy white beard and moustache, wearing a red wool tunic with white trim and a wide brown leather belt, grey wool trousers, sturdy brown leather boots, and a soft red knitted pointed tomte hat whose tip flops over to one side.

characters.label: Nissen
characters.look: A small, stocky Scandinavian Christmas nisse (workshop elf), cheerful, rosy cheeks, round button nose, a short reddish-brown beard, short tousled reddish-brown hair, wearing a grey cable-knit wool sweater, a brown leather work apron, dark green knee breeches, red and white striped wool stockings and brown wooden clogs. Bare head, nothing on the head.

characters.label: Nissen med flätor
characters.look: A small, cheerful Scandinavian Christmas nisse (workshop elf), young woman, round face with freckles and rosy cheeks, two thick blonde braids, wearing a red knitted cardigan over a cream linen blouse, a brown leather work apron, a grey wool skirt, green wool stockings and brown wooden clogs. Bare head, nothing on the head.
